entities.name: Tin Can Cathedral
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Tin Can Cathedral was the first independent Ukrainian church in North America. It was the heart of the Seraphimite Church. Founded in Winnipeg, it had no affiliation with any church in Europe.
